"""Track complete original double-past examples and exact boundary proposals.

Preparation only: no repository fixture, grammar, or review disposition changes.
"""
import gzip,hashlib,json,re,subprocess,unicodedata
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/josh/projects/klem')
source_path=Path('/tmp/klem-double-past-prefinal-source-discovery.json.gz')
capture=json.loads(gzip.decompress(source_path.read_bytes()))
output=Path('/tmp/klem-double-past-prefinal-target-proposals.json')
assert not output.exists()
rows=[
('68836',0,0,'작았었다','작다','다'),
('68836',1,0,'살았었다','살다','다'),
('68836',2,0,'갔었다','가다','다'),
('68836',3,1,'알아봤었는데','알아보다','는데'),
('68838',0,0,'컸었다','크다','다'),
('68838',1,0,'예뻤었어','예쁘다','어'),
('68838',2,0,'적었었다','적다','다'),
('68838',3,1,'두었었는데요','두다','는데'),
('68840',0,0,'잘했었다','잘하다','다'),
('68840',1,0,'했었다','하다','다'),
('68840',2,1,'노력했었는데','노력하다','는데')]
cases=[]
for ident,index,ti,surface,lemma,ending in rows:
 group=next(g for g in capture['all_original_groups'] if (g['source'],g['index'])==('krdict:'+ident,index))
 text=group['original'][ti];assert text.count(surface)==1
 start=text.index(surface)
 case_id=f'double-past-prefinal-{ident}-1-{index}-{ti}-{start}'
 forms=['었','었',ending];kinds=['prefinal','prefinal','ending']
 if surface=='두었었는데요':forms.append('요');kinds.append('particle')
 judgment={'id':case_id+'-structure','lemmas':[lemma],'lemma_kinds':['predicate'],'morphemes':forms,'morpheme_kinds':kinds,'required_rules':['prefinal.past'],'verdict':'required','source':'double-past-prefinal-'+ident,'reason':'Original source-owned structural proposal; two ordered canonical past components retain 았었/었었/였었 allomorphs. Source sense is provenance; contextual temporal interpretation and independent review remain unjudged.'}
 case={'id':case_id,'surface':surface,'source_occurrence':{**group,'text_index':ti,'character_span':[start,start+len(surface)]},'judgments':[judgment]}
 if surface=='두었었는데요':case['judgments'].append({**judgment,'id':case_id+'-whole-polite','morphemes':['었','었','는데요'],'morpheme_kinds':['prefinal','prefinal','ending']})
 cases.append(case)
negative=[('가었었다','가다','68838',2),('먹았었다','먹다','68836',2),('하았었다','하다','68840',2),('하었었다','하다','68840',2),('좋었었다','좋다','68838',2),('먹었었었다','먹다','68838',3)]
for i,(surface,lemma,source,count) in enumerate(negative):
 ident=f'double-past-prefinal-boundary-{i}'
 cases.append({'id':ident,'surface':surface,'judgments':[{'id':ident+'-specific-past','lemmas':[lemma],'lemma_kinds':['predicate'],'morphemes':['었']*count+['다'],'morpheme_kinds':['prefinal']*count+['ending'],'verdict':'forbidden','source':'double-past-prefinal-'+source,'reason':'Named spelling-boundary proposal for this exact lemma and ordered past/final path. The third-past cap is an implementation-boundary regression, not a claim that the source explicitly prohibits all triple-past strings. Identity and other lexical analyses remain outside this judgment.'}]})
observed=[]
for g in capture['all_original_groups']:
 for ti,text in enumerate(g['original']):
  for match in re.finditer(r'[가-힣]+',text):
   if sum((ord(ch)-0xAC00)%28==20 for ch in match[0])>=2:
    observed.append({'source':g['source'],'sense':g['sense'],'index':g['index'],'text_index':ti,'character_span':[match.start(),match.end()],'surface':match[0]})
assert len(observed)==11
assert {(r['source'],r['index'],r['text_index'],r['surface']) for r in observed}=={('krdict:'+sid,i,t,w) for sid,i,t,w,_,_ in rows}
cli=next(p for p in capture['frozen_inputs'] if p.endswith('/bin/klem'))
db=next(p for p in capture['frozen_inputs'] if p.endswith('.db'))
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in capture['frozen_inputs'].items())
probes=[]
for encoding in ['NFC','NFD']:
 for mode,flags in [('raw',[]),('compatible',['--dict-compatible'])]:
  for case in cases:
   command=[cli,'word',unicodedata.normalize(encoding,case['surface']),'--dictionary',db,*flags]
   r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,capture_output=True,check=True);response=json.loads(r.stdout)
   observations=[]
   for j in case['judgments']:
    matching=[a for a in response['analyses'] if [l['text'] for l in a['lemmas']]==j['lemmas'] and [l['kind'] for l in a['lemmas']]==j['lemma_kinds'] and [m['form'] for m in a['morphemes']]==j['morphemes'] and [m['kind'] for m in a['morphemes']]==j['morpheme_kinds'] and set(j.get('required_rules',[]))<=set(a['rules'])]
    assert bool(matching)==(j['verdict']=='required'),(case['id'],encoding,mode,j['id'])
    observations.append({'judgment':j['id'],'matching_paths':matching})
   probes.append({'case':case['id'],'encoding':encoding,'mode':mode,'command':command,'exit_code':0,'json':r.stdout.decode(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),'observations':observations})
assert len(probes)==68
producer=Path(__file__)
report={'schema_version':1,'preparation_only':True,'source_capture_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'cases':cases,'literal_double_ss_observations':observed,'probes':probes,'producer':{'text':producer.read_text(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(producer.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'scope':'All eleven complete original groups have independently scanned double-ss occurrences and twelve required structural proposals, including both polite decompositions. Six exact boundary proposals were observed in NFC/NFD raw and compatible modes. Triple-past cap belongs to implementation regression scope; source semantics, all-candidate precision, dictionary-owner closure and GUI source representation remain pending.','contextual_verdict':'unjudged','independent_review':'pending'}
output.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Prepared11 original groups,12 required/6 exact forbidden proposals,68 actual probes; no repository changes.',flush=True)
